summary.headline: Security Copilot material for Intune and vulnerability remediation is introduced
summary.overview: New Security Copilot in Intune overview material and related integration guidance were published alongside updates for the Vulnerability Remediation Agent and device query.
summary.adminImpact: Security and endpoint teams evaluating Copilot should use the new overview and Intune integration guidance to understand the documented capabilities before planning agent access, operational ownership, or vulnerability-remediation workflows.

keyChanges.title: Security Copilot in Intune feature overview is added
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft published a new overview of Security Copilot features in Intune.

keyChanges.title: Security Copilot in Microsoft Intune guidance is added
keyChanges.detail: New documentation covers Security Copilot in Microsoft Intune.

keyChanges.title: Vulnerability Remediation Agent usage guidance is updated
keyChanges.detail: The documentation describing use of the Vulnerability Remediation Agent was revised.

summary.headline: Security Copilot agents in Intune receive a new documentation set
summary.overview: The archive adds a focused set of Security Copilot agent references for Intune, including an agent overview, setup material, requirements, and vulnerability-remediation management guidance. A previous Intune Vulnerability Remediation Agent page was removed as this material was introduced.
summary.adminImpact: Use the new agent documentation when assessing readiness, permissions, and operating procedures. Update bookmarks and internal runbooks that reference the removed legacy vulnerability-remediation page.

keyChanges.title: Security Copilot Agents in Intune overview is added
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft added a new entry point for Security Copilot agents in Intune.

keyChanges.title: Vulnerability Remediation Agent management guidance is added
keyChanges.detail: New documentation describes using the Vulnerability Remediation Agent to manage vulnerabilities.

keyChanges.title: Legacy Vulnerability Remediation Agent page is removed
keyChanges.detail: The earlier Intune Vulnerability Remediation Agent documentation page was removed, indicating that administrators should follow the new agent documentation paths.

summary.headline: Security Copilot agents, remote retire guidance, and Autopilot material define the week
summary.overview: The week combines a large Security Copilot agent documentation release with new remote-device retire guidance, updated Autopilot hybrid connector proxy documentation, and device-query updates.
summary.adminImpact: Security and endpoint operations teams should assess the new Copilot agent guidance and align support processes with it. Review retire-action and Autopilot proxy references before changing remote-device operations or hybrid Autopilot connectivity.

keyChanges.title: Remote Device Action: Retire guidance is added
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft added documentation for the Intune remote device action to retire a device.

keyChanges.title: Security Copilot agents documentation is introduced
keyChanges.detail: A new documentation entry point for Security Copilot agents in Intune was published.

keyChanges.title: Autopilot hybrid connector proxy guidance is refreshed
keyChanges.detail: The Windows Autopilot hybrid connector proxy documentation was updated.

summary.headline: March pairs policy and device-management guidance with a new Security Copilot agent surface
summary.overview: March's Intune archive includes new settings-catalog policy migration guidance and a new Security Copilot agents documentation set, plus significant updates across Configuration Manager, Windows Autopilot device preparation, and Remote Help.
summary.adminImpact: Treat the settings-catalog tutorial and Copilot agent references as the current starting points for planned work. Review updated endpoint-security, Autopilot, and remote-support guidance where existing operational documentation may now be stale.

keyChanges.title: Settings catalog policy migration walkthrough is added
keyChanges.detail: A new walkthrough covers creating a settings catalog policy for Group Policy migration work.

keyChanges.title: Security Copilot agents documentation is introduced
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft added the Security Copilot agents in Intune documentation entry point.

keyChanges.title: Windows Autopilot device preparation update guidance is refreshed
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft updated the release notes for Windows Autopilot device preparation.

summary.headline: Security baseline references and the March Intune service update are published
summary.overview: The day includes updates to Intune security baseline settings and the What's new reference, accompanied by a Message Center notice for the March 2026 Intune service update.
summary.adminImpact: Check Tenant Status for the service build and review the March update notes before adjusting baseline policy or communicating feature availability to administrators and support teams.

keyChanges.title: March 2026 Intune service update is announced
keyChanges.detail: Microsoft states that the March 2026 service update introduces a new service build visible in Tenant Status and directs administrators to the What's new page and related blogs for feature details.

keyChanges.title: Security baseline settings reference is updated
keyChanges.detail: The documentation for Intune MDM security baseline settings was updated.
